title: Ndop example
description: Scaffold an example of a registry item (ADR-0014): registry/examples/<item>-<case>.ts, its registry.json entry, the item's examples list, and the harness route that renders and tests it.

item.description: The item it shows, for example `button`.

case.description: What the example shows, in kebab-case, for example `demo` or `with-icon`. The example is named `<item>-<case>`.

description.description: One sentence on what it shows, which the docs print as its "when to use this" line.
